entry.content:
# Mario Sports Mix AP v3.1.0 - THE Bugfix! ## It's finally here!! Hopefully within a couple days you should see Mario Sports Mix on Ionium!! (If nothing goes wrong...) ### This release is NOT compatible with any prior 3.1.0 release...
### Breaking Changes!
- **Start With Random Sports:** Now accepts a number from `0–4` instead of on/off. Default: `4`. - **Start with Party Modes:** Now accepts `0–4` instead of on/off. Default: `0`. - Either Start With Random Sports OR Start With Party Modes must be at least 1! If not, the generator will pick a random amount of Sports OR Party Modes to start with. - **Enable Points Win (Basketball/Hockey):** Now has three options: `off`, `win_set`, and `win_round`. - **Death Link Action:** The default is now `losing_a_match`. Ties only trigger Death Link if you select `losing_or_tying_a_match`. - **Enabled Party Modes:** Now defaults to none instead of Feed Petey and Smash Skate.
### Added
#### Gameplay and Progression
- Added **Progressive Party Mode Court**, which unlocks party mode courts and songs across three tiers when Progressive Court is enabled. - You can now choose how many random sports and party modes you start with. - Added a safeguard that grants 1–4 random sports or party modes if you would otherwise start with neither. - Starting sports and party modes are limited to the number you've enabled. - Added **Win Round** for Basketball and Hockey, allowing the point target to end the entire round instead of just a set or period.
#### Client Features
- Added a settings group for configuring your game ISO and Dolphin executable. - Added automatic Dolphin launching when `auto_open` is enabled. - Check your host.yaml for both of these! - Added `/roster_fix` to fix overlapping roster characters. - Added a background roster patch that applies automatically at startup. - Added `/super_debug` to display game, boss/goal, and Death Link status. - Added the ability to skip the four sport tutorials. - Improved goal tracking across disconnects and reconnects. - Death Link health recovery for Behemoth and Behemoth King now appears as a coloured chat message. - Improved client messages when waiting for game memory or when no save file is loaded.
#### Documentation and Packaging
- Updated the README, setup guide, and known-bugs documentation. - Added an Alt Paths Guide link and Mac setup instructions. - Added a new application icon. - Updated packaging to exclude developer files from the distributed APWorld.
### Changed
#### Logic and Generation
- **Special Meter** is now a progression item regardless of Special Sanity. - Cup, alternate path, and Sports Mix entrances now correctly require their corresponding sport unlocks. - Progressive Court requirements now scale with enabled sports instead of using a fixed number of courts. - Party mode courts now use individual logic, including the new progressive tiers. - Improved validation for Special Sanity and Character Sanity settings. - Generation is now deterministic: the same seed and YAML produce consistent results. - Improved Universal Tracker compatibility. - Reorganised Harmony Hustle songs to match the new tier layout. - Renamed item groups to avoid naming conflicts.
#### Client Behaviour
- Updated game memory addresses for Behemoth HP and exhibition difficulty. - Should fix goal error! - Fixed Flower Cup bridge-toggle logic. - Improved item processing and court unlock order. - Corrected Death Link behaviour for losses, ties, and received effects. - Fixed score detection for set-based and round-based point wins. - Improved disconnect handling and Final Fantasy character unlock logic.
### Fixed
- Improved Death Link and point-based goal tracking to prevent missed or duplicated updates caused by desynchronised local state. - Fixed memory-address lookups affecting alternate paths, current nodes, rounds, cups, and sports. - Fixed errors when checking the game region before memory initialises. - Fixed errors when no save file is loaded. - Removed incorrect entries from the Harmony Hustle item table. - Fixed party mode enabled/disabled checks.

entry.title: Ys Origin v2.1.1
entry.content:
A patch release: the 3F barrier fix from a Hugo player's report, and a logic audit against the game's room scripts. Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**.
> **Take all three files, and take them together.** Seeds generated with 2.1.0 stay playable with the new dll.
## 🛠️ Mod fix
- **The 3F Transfer Room now always sends you to 4F first.** Its barrier teleports Yunica and Hugo to 4F unless the Blue Necklace is worn, and that teleport is the only way into the 4F rooms. A seed can hand you the necklace early, and walking in wearing it broke the barrier for good, so 4F was out of reach. Until you have been to 4F, the barrier now ignores the necklace. - **Saves already stuck this way are repaired.** If you broke the barrier before ever reaching 4F, it comes back the next time you are in a room next to it. Walk into it to be teleported to 4F, then come back with the necklace on to break it again.
## 🗺️ Logic
Ten places where the logic counted on a check or a passage the game blocks, found by checking every room against its scripts: - six room gates, including the 6F room (wind in, dash out), the 8F dive and the 24F bridge's way back; - four story checks, including Yunica's Black Pearl, which now waits for her 19F event; - the 2F Gemma Room's two checks are Yunica's and Hugo's only (Toal cannot enter it).
## ⚠️ What was and was not played
- The barrier fix was loaded in the retail game and its check was exercised in memory for each case. The room itself was not played through. - The logic changes passed AP's integration check, 60 random seeds and 8 three-player seeds.
## 🐞 Known issues
- **Rado's Annex and story order** (from 2.1.0) is still not fixed in this dll. Hugo and Yunica can be turned around at the Rado Tower bridge by story flags from higher floors. - The known issues listed for 2.1.0 still apply.

entry.title: DUSK v0.4.2
entry.content:
## Changes
- Combat logic reworked: the combat_logic option now has three settings, from easiest to hardest: - easy (new default): the logic expects the most guns, earliest. Episode 1 needs 1 gun from E1M3 and 2 from E1M6. Episode 2 needs 2 from E2M2 and 3 from E2M6. Episode 3 needs 3 from E3M2 and 4 from E3M6. - normal: one gun fewer at every step. Episode 1 needs 1 gun from E1M6. Episode 2 needs 1 from E2M2 and 2 from E2M6. Episode 3 needs 2 from E3M2 and 3 from E3M6. - unhinged: no combat logic. You may play a long time with only the sickles. - Each episode’s first level never needs a gun. Secret levels need as many as the end of their episode. The Sword doesn’t count as a gun. - E2M1 developer pickups removed: a hidden developer stash in E2M1 (16 extra blue keys and a sword) is no longer part of the randomizer. That’s 17 fewer checks. E2M1’s real blue key is now named E2M1 - Blue Key. - Linux, Steam Deck and macOS setup: the Setup Guide now has install instructions for each system, including Steam Deck with native Linux or Proton. These platforms haven’t been tested in game yet, so reports are welcome.
## Fixes
- Build: fixed a build error introduced in 0.4.1. It only affected people building the mod themselves.
## Upgrading
- Update both dusk.apworld and the mod ZIP. - YAML changes for combat_logic: - normal used to mean the strictest rules. That setting is now called easy, and normal now has the looser rules that used to be called lenient. If your YAML says combat_logic: normal and you want the old behaviour, change it to easy or remove the line. - lenient and none still work. They now mean normal and unhinged. - If your YAML refers to E2M1 - Blue Key 1 (for example in exclude_locations), rename it to E2M1 - Blue Key.

entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r2
entry.content:
It's time for some new features! The main things are adding Unique Units and Unique Buildings to the itempool. I've also made an "AP World" Civilization with no UU/UB/starting techs as part of the eventual "blank slate" I want (though adding traits to the itempool appears to be much harder than I thought). This is very much a first draft of the feature (especially UBs), so make sure to read the notes before using them.
### Changelog: - Added options to add Unique Units and Unique Buildings to the itempool. The way it works is to randomly add as many as it can as "useful" items. - Added an AP World Civilization, so you can properly use Unique Building items and not break logic with starting techs--it's meant to be used with unrestricted leaders, and I'm also not sure if the AI can roll into that Civ randomly (something I want to change if it can). - Fixed a typo that caused the Great Spy item to spawn a regular spy instead.
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel). 5. The "AP" Unique Units can't be upgraded into, though they can be upgraded themselves. This is planned to be fixed in an upcoming update. 6. AP Unique Buildings are programmed assuming you don't have a "natural" Unique Building for your Civilization for purposes like avoiding duplicates of the same class of building, so if you use a Civilization other than AP World things could break. 7. If a building has a requirement to be built (such as the University), and you build an AP Unique Building version of it (such as the Seowon), you aren't able to build the original version anymore. There's no reason why you'd need to do this (the only vanilla building that's not strictly worse than the UB alternatives is the Theatre/Hippodrome, and that doesn't suffer the bug), but it's weird behavior.
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet. 4. If you add Unique Buildings to the itempool, it causes a noticeable amount of lag when entering the city screen in some cases (due to the coding I need to make them work how I want them to). I think it scales with the amount of cities you have, but it also might be just a memory leak. If you experience this lag (or don't and think you would), let me know!
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.3
entry.content: ## Changes ### Added - **`!ap loadout` equips weapons you don't own.** Pick a slot, then any weapon your class can hold in it. The list puts the weapons with the most Archipelago buffs first and shows how many each one has. Stock weapons are not listed, since you already have them: Reset at the end of the list puts your own weapon back. The choice lasts until you leave the server. It applies at once in the spawn room or between waves, otherwise at your next resupply. Slots the run has not unlocked stay locked. It asks before it does anything. ### Fixed - **Servers work on the TF2 update of 16 October 2026.** Windows SigMod servers no longer refuse to start or crash on every community mission, and the defender bots read item and attribute data correctly again on Windows and Linux. - **Windows SigMod servers play every community mission to the end.** The test servers now clear all 532 waves of the SigMod community missions. - **Spy stabs alert nearby robots** on Linux SigMod servers. - **The Your Eternal Reward unnerf works again on Linux.** The last TF2 update had broken it. - **More SigMod mods work on Windows servers:** 254 of the 309 mods now load in full. - **Caliginous Caper wave 666 no longer ends when the 64 Spies die.** Valve lists the tanks that wait for the Spies ahead of them, and the game ends the wave on the tick the last Spy dies, before the tanks, the crit robots and the Uber Medics that follow. The repaired file now lists each group after the ones it waits for. The server writes it again at start. - **Weapon buffs no longer pile up on Windows servers.** Each time the game rebuilt your buffs, the reserve ammo and the health you were holding went up by the buff again, and switching weapons rebuilds them twice. A +25% reserve ammo buff read 511, 797, 1243 and kept going, and a max health buff added its amount to your health every time. The buffs themselves were right. The plugin now puts back the ammo and health a rebuild raised. It does not top up your ammo or health when you first earn a buff; the next resupply does that. The Linux server we measured did not do this. We ran ten rebuilds in a row on a Windows and a Linux server with scripted defender bots, but no real player has checked it yet. - **Windows servers run on the 2026-10-14 TF2 update.** The update moved the game code SigMod patches, and a SigMod built for the old game refuses to load on the new one. The Windows launcher now installs a SigMod built for TF2 11117211. Missions that need SigMod load again. - **Windows SigMod servers no longer crash when bots use items or when a mission is cleared.** A bot using an item (a canteen, say) could crash the server, and so could clearing a mission with a thousand robots or more. Both came from game functions the Windows SigMod had not found. We played the missions on a Windows server with scripted defender bots; all but one mission played through, and that one still stops at its first wave. - **More SigMod mods work on a Windows server.** Weapon effects, death yells and entity limits did nothing there, because the Windows SigMod had not found the game functions they hook. They now run. We played the missions on a Windows server with scripted defender bots: five of eight groups played through. Three missions still lose waves (Dismal Devilry, Dust to Dust and Trespasser Remaster) and are being looked at. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. entry.title: Mario Tennis GBC v0.2.0
entry.content:
## New options
- **`shot_items`** (default off): your shots become items. - **Strokes:** topspin, slice and the flat shot. The second copy of each adds its power shot (the smash, for the flat shot). - **Lob and drop shot.** - **Serves:** topspin, slice and flat. The second copy adds the nice serve. - You start with one random stroke and one random serve. A locked shot plays the first stroke or serve you own. - **Logic:** - Story matches want more shots as you climb: 3 for Senior, 5 for Varsity, 8 for the Island Open, 11 for the Dream Match. - Shot-hungry mini-games and drills want the shots they need. - Anything that can still be won without the shots shows as glitched logic in Universal Tracker. - **`experience_modifier`** (default normal): scales every EXP award, from ×0.5 up to ×5. That covers story, exhibition and linked matches, drills, and EXP Bundles. - **`nerf_two_on_one`** (default off): Bowser's Two-on-One plays 2 games per set instead of 6. - **`skip_ceremony`** (default off): winning the Island Open final skips the fireworks and the Awards Ceremony. You go straight from the bracket to the congratulations artwork and credits. - **`dream_match_difficulty`** (default intense): sets how hard Mario plays in Peach's first Dream Match offer: hard, intense or max. After a win she offers all three, as usual.
## Locations
- **New:** each class's practice match, in both arcs (6 locations). Each one still needs that class's pass. - **Removed:** the three mini-game record-court locations. - That makes 88 locations in total.
## Logic
- **Mini-games:** - Perfect Shot needs the lob. - Target Shot levels 2 and 3 need the drop shot, and want the lob. - Two-on-One wants the Dream Match's shot count. - **Drills:** a level's logic includes the level before it. Service Matches want a nice serve, and are glitched without one.
## Other changes to the game
- **Academy front gate:** once both the Island Open and Peach's Castle are open, the gate opens an Island Open / Mario World menu. Pressing B walks you back into the Academy. - **Assigning EXP:** - Select gives the highlighted character all the remaining EXP. - Holding the increase keeps speeding up, past the original game's top speed, to as much as 64 points a frame.

entry.title: Spyro 2 v2.2.0
entry.content:
This release modifies both the Duckstation client (S2AP.Desktop.exe) and the APWorld (including the Bizhawk client). This release is not compatible with previous versions. As this release patches a significant DataStorage usage issue with the Duckstation client, full gemsanity players are urged to update immediately.
New Features: - Players can now menu out of Glimmer before entering Summer Forest for the first time. - Game overs prior to entering Summer Forest continue to redirect the player to Glimmer, as in vanilla.
Changes: - The minimum supported AP version is now 0.6.6, up from 0.6.1. - Most users will no longer need to run the Duckstation client in admin mode. This is no longer forced on opening it. - Gemsanity Rework - Gem locations and items are now separated. - The player may specify how many gems to become locations. - Gems will behave normally if only locations are added. - Adding 500 or more locations requires host approval. - Simplified gem item options. - When choosing gem bundles or full gemsanity, the player's gem location count may be overridden to provide enough locations. - If not logically required, red gems are now filler items. Otherwise, they are converted to green and blue gems. - This significantly improves the speed of generation and success rate for full gemsanity. - When Level Locks are on, beating Ripto unlocks Dragon Shores permanently. - The lock now only prevents entering from out of bounds. - The trick enabling wall access from Zephyr with Double Jump now also grants access to the two gems outside Metro Speedway into logic. (Coded by PhoenixAki)
Bug Fixes - [Duckstation] Fixed a critical bug where inefficient DataStorage use could cause issues up to and including crashes in full gemsanity seeds. - Fixed a logic error that incorrectly handled the warp from Crush to Autumn Plains when the player had swim but not climb. - [Bizhawk] Fixed a pair of bugs around Sparx range and the Lazy Sparx Trap. - Fixed a bug where loading into an in-progress gemsanity seed could release checks based on your vanilla progression instead of your AP progression. - [Duckstation] Fixed a bug where connecting before in game could cause filler items received offline to be lost. - Fixed a bug where Elora could let the player into the Ripto fight early under rare circumstances.
